title: Be a Good Host and Guest

topics.name: Polite words: please, may I, thank you
Prepositions of time: at, on, in

questions.rule: A command (imperative) starts with the base form of the verb: Be punctual.
Use on with days: on Sunday, on Monday.
After will, use the base form: will be.
